newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt arrests alleged militant finance manager.
newsitem.headline: Egypt arrests alleged militant finance manager.

text.p: Egyptian police arrested on Tuesday a 36-year-old fugitive they suspect of being the financial manager of the southern branch of the country's largest Moslem militant organisation, security sources said.
They said police in the southern province of Assiut arrested Tarek Bedeir, a suspected member of al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), in the town of Medinet el-Arbieen.
Bedeir, wanted in connection with six trials, was on the run from several charges including burning down video tape rental shops and trying to kill a policeman, the sources added.
More than 1,000 people have been killed since the Gama'a and other militant groups took up arms against the government in 1992. The groups want to transform Egypt into a purist Moslem state.
The sources say Bedeir was responsible for buying the group's arms and sheltering other gunmen from the law.
